proposedClassification.represented: Eligible population member reconciled to an applicable CMDB CI
proposedClassification.unrepresented: Eligible population member with no verified applicable CMDB representation
proposedClassification.discovery_only: Asset discovered but not resolved to an eligible CMDB CI; may be outside scope or require review
proposedClassification.cmdb_only: CI exists without current discovery evidence; not necessarily invalid, especially for isolated/controlled populations
proposedClassification.unresolved_identity: Match ambiguous, conflicting, or below the approved confidence threshold
proposedClassification.excluded: Explicitly approved out-of-scope population or record with supporting rationale

metricDefinition.numeratorProposed: Count distinct eligible managed assets with verified required CMDB representation at measurement time
metricDefinition.denominatorProposed: Count distinct eligible assets in a governed population baseline, based on approved discovery and/or controlled population evidence
metricDefinition.denominatorWarning: The union of discovery and CMDB records is an observed universe, not proof of the total required population. Assets absent from both need independent population evidence if true coverage is claimed.
metricDefinition.targets: TBD, no objective or tolerance assumed
unknowns: Acceptable CMDB CI status and identity matching
